papers.title_en: Calibrating LLM Explanations to Human Decisions with Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Dong Shu, Ziyang Guo, Negar Kamali, Matthew Groh, Jessica Hullman
papers.evidence: 优化人工智能解释以提升人的决策质量
papers.tldr: 大模型自身判断准确或解释受欢迎，并不意味着解释能帮助人类正确决策。本文提出HD-RL，用真实人类决策校准决策模拟器，再以代理奖励优化解释。在AI生成文本检测任务中，初始解释下的人类准确率仅为51.3%；优化Qwen 3.6后，随机实验中经广义线性混合模型估计的准确率达到63.7%，优于多种基线。研究将解释优化目标从模型表现或主观偏好转向人类决策质量。
papers.abstract_en: Explanations of LLM outputs are considered an important way to make model behavior legible, helping human users make good decisions on downstream tasks. However, default training approaches for improving explanations target model task performance or human preference rather than human decision quality. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{HD-RL}, a reinforcement learning framework for optimizing LLM explanations for human decision making. Our approach calibrates a human decision simulator on observed human decisions, applying a proxy reward model to optimize the LLM to generate explanations that help people to make good decisions. We apply this framework to AI-generated text detection. In our initial data collection phase, we observed that while LLMs possess strong autonomous detection capabilities, the explanations they generate for users yield near-random human accuracy (51.3\%). By applying the HD-RL framework to the open-source Qwen 3.6 model, we generate optimized explanations that improve human performance, achieving a GLMM-estimated human accuracy of 63.7\% in a randomized between-subjects experiment with repeated measures and outperforming RLVR, RLAIF, and other baselines by over 8\%.

papers.title_en: Scoping the Landscape of Large Language Model-based Affective Personal Informatics: Review, Reflection, Future Direction
papers.authors: Minjie Liu, Lihuan Li, Xuran Li, Flora Salim, Benjamin Tag
papers.evidence: 综述用于情绪自我觉察与心理健康的大语言模型系统
papers.tldr: 大语言模型正在改变情感个人信息学，帮助用户记录、分析和反思个人情绪，但相关系统缺乏全面综述。本文系统分析了2020年1月至2026年6月间四个计算与健康领域主要数据库中的45篇论文，梳理宏观趋势、系统分类与研究方法。结果发现，现有系统过度依赖多阶段文本管线，交互以主动操作屏幕为主，评估样本明显偏向年轻校园人群。研究据此提出端到端多模态、低负担且更具包容性的系统发展方向。
papers.abstract_en: Affective personal informatics (PI) involves capturing, tracking, analyzing, and reflecting on personal data to support emotional self-awareness and mental well-being. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) are reshaping affective PI, yet a comprehensive survey of LLM-based affective PI systems is lacking. To bridge this gap, we systematically analyzed 45 papers published between January 2020 and June 2026 across four major computing and health databases, examining their macro trends, system taxonomies, and research methodologies. Our synthesis reveals an overreliance on multi-stage, text-centric pipelines, a predominance of active, screen-bound interactions, and a severe demographic skew toward young, university-campus-based cohorts in empirical evaluations. Based on these findings, we critically reflect on prevailing architectural and methodological shortcomings and outline actionable future directions for building end-to-end multimodal, low-burden, and inclusive affective PI systems.

papers.title_en: From Caricature to Collective Artifact: How Persona Construction Drives Polarization in Generative Social Simulations
papers.authors: Dimitris Michailidis, Petter Törnberg, Fernando P. Santos
papers.evidence: 研究人物设定如何影响基于大语言模型的群体极化模拟
papers.tldr: 大语言模型生成的人设可能将个体简化为刻板形象，但这些偏差如何经互动演变为集体极化尚不清楚。研究在类推特仿真平台中，以美国全国选举研究调查构建人设，消融情感极化标记、政党认同和投票选择。仅移除少量明确党派表述，网络便从近乎完全隔离转向接近真实推特的跨党派连接水平。研究指出，调查答案被转写为行为指令可能夸大议题显著性，单项结果吻合不足以证明仿真有效。
papers.abstract_en: Generative Social Simulation (GSS) leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to create sophisticated personas that define agents with demographics, emotions, and political opinions. While prior work shows that personas compress outputs into stereotypical caricatures, there is no comprehensive study of how these caricatures evolve into collective artifacts when they interact. Using a Twitter-like GSS platform with personas derived from the American National Elections Study (ANES), we ablate three layers of partisan identity: affective polarization markers, party identification, and vote choice, while retaining demographics, ideological positioning and important issues. We find that collective outcomes depend heavily on how survey responses are translated into personas. Removing a few explicitly partisan statements moves the network from near-complete segregation to cross-party ties approaching those of real Twitter networks. We argue that matching one outcome is not evidence for behavioral validity and point to salience as a possible explanation. Surveys ask for a position on every question regardless of its importance to the respondent, and persona construction turns each answer into a direct behavioral instruction. We conclude with a checklist for more comprehensive evaluation of personas in future works.

papers.title_en: Cowork-Gym: Synthesizing Interactive Work Environments at Scale
papers.authors: Anni Zou, Cheng Chen, Jiaji Deng, Weikang Zhou, Xinji Mai, Yue Wu, Jianing Lin, Lipeng Xie, Lixiong Qin, Qingyue Zhao, Que Shen, Shuchang Tao, Xuchen Pan, Yaliang Li, Yunpeng Zhai, Yushuo Chen, Zhihai Wang, Zhuo Zhang, Zhaoyang Liu, Bolin Ding, Jingren Zhou
papers.evidence: 模拟工作场景中智能体响应用户要求并适应共享工作区修改
papers.tldr: 协作智能体需跨工具和文件处理依赖，并适应用户需求与共享工作区的动态变化，训练环境难以规模化构建。Cowork-Gym通过“构建—执行—修订”闭环校验和修复环境，并用有状态用户模拟器生成对话与工作区编辑。研究合成覆盖14类场景的6.49万个环境，用于后训练三种规模的Qwen模型，六项基准平均提升4.1至8.7分。27B模型综合排名第二，表明动态协作环境合成可有效支持智能体训练。
papers.abstract_en: Cowork agents navigate dependencies across tools and files while adapting to changing user requirements and edits to shared workspaces. Scaling such environments requires maintaining consistency among task objectives, executable resources, user behavior, and success criteria. We introduce Cowork-Gym, a framework that synthesizes Cowork environments through a build-execute-revise loop that uses execution evidence and review feedback to validate and repair generated environments. To capture realistic Cowork dynamics, a stateful user simulator responds to the agent's actions through dialogue and direct edits to the shared workspace. We synthesize 64.9K environments across 14 application scenarios and use them to post-train 9B, 27B, and 35B-A3B Qwen models with supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and on-policy distillation. Averaged across six agentic benchmarks, these models outperform their corresponding base checkpoints by 8.7, 6.4, and 4.1 points, respectively. Ours-27B ranks second overall among the evaluated models and achieves the highest average scores on PawBench and ClawEval, outperforming models with over 100B total parameters on both benchmarks.

papers.title_en: Interaction-as-a-Judge
papers.authors: Wayne Chi, I-Hung Hsu, Li Chen, Wei-Lin Chiang, Ion Stoica, Anastasios Nikolas Angelopoulos, Ameet Talwalkar, Chris Donahue, Cho-Jui Hsieh
papers.evidence: 让计算机使用智能体直接交互以评估应用
papers.tldr: 现有交互式应用评测多依赖代码分析和单元测试，容易漏掉用户实际操作时显现的故障。论文提出让计算机使用智能体直接操作应用，再依据多模态交互轨迹进行评判。实验中，人类偏好预测准确率从65.6%升至69.1%，五次尝试内的故障需求修复率达到75.5%。作者还发布两类人工标注数据集，并验证交互评判可作为推理时反馈和训练时奖励，同时改善评测与应用生成质量。
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are tasked with producing sophisticated interactive applications such as websites, desktop applications, and games. While humans assess these applications interactively, current automated LLM evaluations primarily focus on code analysis and unit tests. This mismatch can cause LLM judges to miss failures that are immediately apparent to human users. We study Interaction-as-a-Judge, an evaluation paradigm where computer-use agents (CUAs) directly interact with an application. We demonstrate that Interaction-as-a-Judge can improve both evaluation and generation of interactive applications. To this end, we collect and release two complementary datasets: $6,858$ pairs of applications with human preferences and corresponding agent traces, and $222$ applications with human-verified requirement labels. Relative to standard non-interactive approaches, we find that Interaction-as-a-Judge improves evaluation in terms of predicting human preferences ($65.6\% \to 69.1\%$) and requirement verification ($77.0\% \to 81.6\%$). We also observe scaling benefits: across both preference alignment and requirement verification, higher-quality interactions improve performance. Finally, through both inference- and training-time experiments, we demonstrate that Interaction-as-a-Judge can also improve the quality of generated artifacts. At inference time, Interaction-as-a-Judge repairs $75.5\%$ of broken requirements within five attempts, compared to $55.4\%$ for code-only self-feedback. At training time, using Interaction-as-a-Judge as a reward signal improves win-rate over the base model by $6.7$pp while reducing both generated code length by $35.7\%$ and build failure rates by $7.2$pp compared to a code-only reward signal.

papers.title_en: From Agents to Edges: Paired Optimization for Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.authors: Feng Lin, Xiaotian Yu, Yifan Yang, Aijun Li
papers.evidence: 优化语言模型智能体间的沟通以提升协作
papers.tldr: 多智能体中，个体能力强并不保证协作有效，信息传递必须与下游的理解和使用方式对齐。PACO将通信边作为优化单元，在固定模型权重、角色和工作流拓扑的前提下，联合优化发送端、接收端指令及共享通信约定。四智能体工作流实验显示，该方法在多个基准上优于提示优化和通信基线，在HotpotQA上学得的配置跨数据集迁移后仍保持优势。优化后的指令直接融入现有提示，部署时无需新增模型调用，为固定系统改善协作提供了路径。
papers.abstract_en: Strong individual agents do not guarantee effective collaboration. Communication must align what one agent conveys with how another interprets and uses it. This dependency makes the communication edge a natural unit of optimization. We introduce Paired Automated Communication Optimization (PACO), which jointly optimizes the instructions at both ends of each edge and their shared communication convention in systems built on black-box language models. PACO keeps model weights, agent roles, and workflow topology fixed. A state-aware discounted bandit selects edges for refinement, while execution feedback guides paired revisions evaluated through staged end-to-end execution. The optimized instructions integrate into existing agent prompts without additional model calls at deployment. On a four-agent workflow evaluated across diverse multi-agent benchmarks, PACO consistently outperforms leading prompt-optimization and communication baselines. Configurations learned on HotpotQA retain their advantage in cross-dataset transfer without target-specific optimization. These results demonstrate that optimizing how agents communicate can substantially improve collaboration within an otherwise fixed system.

papers.title_en: Multi-System Cognitive Steering for Generative Communication
papers.authors: Eric Lacosse, Pablo Tano, Daniel C. McNamee
papers.evidence: 结合多模态上下文推断意图并引导生成式交流。
papers.tldr: 高运动输入成本限制了辅助沟通的速度与表达能力，而生成式模型扩写缩略文本时又容易误解意图。论文提出认知引导框架，将环境指代、情绪状态和沟通动机等多模态上下文与模型控制方法结合。在模拟缩略语基准上，前五候选扩写准确率最高约为88%，约为无上下文基线的两倍。研究发现，场景物体更适合通过文本提示注入，情绪则可能更适合内部激活调控，为兼顾沟通效率与意图保真的混合接口提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: A fundamental bottleneck for translating thoughts to speech is the high physical cost of motor input forcing a strict tradeoff between communication speed and expressivity. Generative AI offers a promising solution by expanding highly abbreviated text input into fluent sentences, significantly reducing the motor burden on the user. However, sparse inputs are inherently ambiguous; without sufficient context, AI models frequently misinterpret these abbreviations and generate outputs that fail to align with the user's true cognitive intent. We propose \textit{Cognitive Steering}, a framework that can be leveraged to reconstruct user intent by grounding Large Language Models (LLMs) in multimodal context and applying AI control methods. We demonstrate that aligning frontier models with selected environmental referents, emotional states, and communication motives on simulated abbreviation benchmarks achieves up to $\sim$88\% top-5 expansion accuracy, doubling no-context baselines. We also reveal that different types of context require distinct AI control techniques: while physical objects in a scene are best provided through explicit text prompts, abstract factors like emotion may be more effectively managed by directly altering the AI's internal activations. These findings suggest a hybrid architecture for future interfaces that leverage Cognitive Steering to help users communicate both quickly and accurately, recruiting multiple AI control methods simultaneously to perfectly capture their intended communication goals.

papers.title_en: Narrowing the Collaboration Gap, Probably
papers.authors: Mirah Shi, Marcel Hussing, Ira Globus-Harris, Natalie Collina, Aaron Roth, Surbhi Goel
papers.evidence: 研究智能体团队如何通过信息交流提升协作
papers.tldr: 多智能体协作时，各自掌握不同的私有信息，仅交流建议动作会丢失影响决策的不确定性。论文提出交流经过校准的动作概率，并在合成推理任务与协作迷宫中检验。理论和实验表明，无偏概率交流可严格优于动作交流，但概率偏差可能使优势消失。作者进一步提出事后对话校准干预，在训练的变换器和预训练大语言模型中改善决策，说明协作收益不仅来自传递更多信息，更依赖可供可靠更新的校准信念。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed as teams of agents that hold different private information about a shared task. How should such agents concisely communicate in a way that promotes aggregation of decision-relevant information? Communicating only proposed actions can discard decision-relevant uncertainty: two agents may prefer the same action for different reasons. We study an alternative interface in which agents communicate calibrated beliefs over actions. We first analyze a simple synthetic setting that captures the structure of multi-round reasoning under partial information. In this setting, we show theoretically and empirically that communicating unbiased probabilities can be strictly more powerful than communicating actions. We then test the same principle in a collaborative maze-solving task with trained transformers and pretrained LLM agents. Our results demonstrate that probability communication outperforms action communication when the exchanged predictions preserve calibrated uncertainty. When communicated probabilities are biased, we show that the benefits of probability communication can disappear. We give a post-hoc conversational calibration intervention that consistently improves decision-making by correcting these biases both in a toy transformer setting and when pretrained LLMs use the corrections in context. These results suggest that probabilistic communication is useful for multi-agent collaboration not merely because it transmits more information, but because calibrated uncertainty gives other agents a reliable object to update on.

papers.title_en: PersEvalBench: Can LLM Evaluators Judge Contextually Appropriate Use of Persona Information?
papers.authors: Xinyi Liu, Hooshang Nayyeri, Emine Yilmaz, Dilek Hakkani-Tur, Charith Peris, Hari Thadakamalla
papers.evidence: 评测助手能否恰当地使用用户历史信息
papers.tldr: 个性化助手日益依赖大模型评审，但评审能否判断用户历史在当前情境中是否适用，仍缺乏验证。研究提出PersEvalBench，包含403个多轮次场景，覆盖个性化不足、过度个性化及状态误用三类九种错误。五个评审模型均存在识别短板；在人评子集上，人类识别个性化不足错误的比例为94.4%，最强评审仅为63.9%。突出相关历史仅略有改善，表明瓶颈不只是获取证据，更在于判断信息应如何影响回答。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) evaluators are increasingly used to assess personalized assistants, yet whether they can reliably judge personalization has rarely been tested. We introduce PersEvalBench, a benchmark testing whether an evaluator can recognize appropriate and inappropriate uses of user history. It contains 403 multi-episode scenarios where user information should persist, transfer, or cease to apply. The benchmark covers nine controlled error subtypes across three families: under-personalization, over-personalization, and misapplied-state errors. Human audits confirm that generated errors match their intended types and that the prescribed uses of user information are reasonable.   Across five LLM evaluators, recognition of controlled personalization errors remains limited even with the full dialogue history. On the human-evaluated subset, under-personalization shows the largest gap: humans recognize 94.4% of these errors, compared with 63.9% for the strongest reported evaluator. Evaluators often recognize that a response is problematic but reverse the error direction, mistaking failure to follow an applicable preference (UNDER) for use of an inapplicable preference (OVER). Easier evidence access offers little help: highlighting the relevant history turns raises error recognition only slightly, suggesting that the remaining difficulty lies in judging what role that information should play in the response.

papers.title_en: AgentSafeEvo: Adversarial Co-Evolution for LLM Agent Safety
papers.authors: Chenxu Wang, Xiaoyu Wen, Han Qi, Ziyuan Zhou, Cheng Jin, Chaochao Lu, Qiaosheng Zhang
papers.evidence: 针对恶意内容操纵工具型智能体并诱发不安全行为进行防护
papers.tldr: 大语言模型智能体在多轮工具交互中，可能受用户请求、工具描述或环境观测中的恶意内容操纵，执行不安全操作。AgentSafeEvo通过对抗协同进化强化学习，让攻击者构造覆盖多类任务与攻击方式的对抗任务，防御者学习安全完成任务。框架依据同一任务内防御奖励的波动调整训练权重，提高任务利用效率。实验表明，该方法增强了对抗鲁棒性，同时保持通用智能体能力，为兼顾行动安全与任务性能提供训练路径。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents accomplish complex tasks through multi-turn interactions with external tools. However, malicious content embedded in user queries, tool descriptions, or environment observations can manipulate their decisions and induce unsafe actions. Adversarial co-evolution has emerged as an effective approach to strengthening LLM safety, but existing work primarily focuses on language-level safety or indirect prompt injection in web tasks. In this paper, we introduce AgentSafeEvo, a co-evolutionary reinforcement learning framework for agent safety built on an attacker-defender game spanning diverse tasks and attack types. The attacker learns to construct adversarial agent tasks that expose weaknesses in the defender's tool use, while the defender learns to complete tasks safely under these attacks. We further introduce learnability-guided task weighting, which uses within-task defender-reward variability to adjust each task's contribution to attacker and defender updates. Extensive experiments on agent safety and general capability benchmarks demonstrate that our method improves adversarial robustness while maintaining general agent capabilities.

papers.title_en: One Monitor Does Not Fit All: Formalism-Agnostic Runtime Verification for Agentic AI
papers.authors: Angelo Ferrando
papers.evidence: 运行时验证监控智能体决策、工具调用与委托行为，以阻止不安全操作。
papers.tldr: 智能体的模型决策、状态更新、工具调用与任务委派分布在不同执行边界，统一监控难以兼顾观测与阻断。AgenticRV以适配器生成规范事件，为各监控器提供独立投影与抽象，再将归一化判定映射为边界支持的反应。受控实验结合时序监控与报告检查，消融显示二者对所选需求均不可缺少。该架构将监控形式与执行边界解耦，并区分被拒尝试与已完成效果，使异构监控方法可在明确假设下复用。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems combine model decisions, mutable state, tool calls, and delegation to external agents. Monitoring them requires observations from different execution boundaries, while prevention requires control before an operation produces its effect. We present AgenticRV, a runtime-verification architecture that separates these boundaries from the monitoring formalism. Adapters emit canonical events; each monitor receives its own projection and abstraction; and a decision policy uses normalised verdicts to select a reaction supported by the responsible adapter. We formalise when observations suffice, monitor replacement preserves decisions, and blocking prevents unsafe effects. We also distinguish rejected attempts from completed effects, avoiding the assumption that a blocked request must leave every monitor in a permanent violation state. The Python implementation supports LangGraph, MCP, and A2A. A controlled LangGraph experiment combines an external Reelay temporal monitor with a programmatic report monitor; ablations show why both are needed for the selected requirements. Differential checks and cross-adapter tests provide further integration evidence. An LLM-driven incident-response example illustrates the same enforcement path, while existing microbenchmarks isolate framework costs. The results support reuse of monitoring methods at explicit control boundaries, subject to the stated observation and deployment assumptions.

papers.title_en: PerSo: Investigating Facets of LLMs' Social Intelligence in Real-World Persuasion Scenarios
papers.authors: Ali Zamani, Soroush Esfahanian, Erfan Shahabi, Mohammad Taher Pilehvar, Azadeh Shakery, Yadollah Yaghoobzadeh
papers.evidence: 在真实改变观点对话中评测语言模型的社交智能与说服行为
papers.tldr: 大语言模型的社会智能既涉及理解他人心理，也涉及据此采取行动，但既有基准多用合成场景且分开评估两者。PerSo基于Reddit的ChangeMyView真实说服对话，通过大模型参与构建任务并经人工标注验证，同时考察认知与行为智能。评测发现，模型表现总体随规模增大而提升，但不同维度存在差异；最强模型在行为任务上略超最佳受测人类，认知任务仍落后。该基准为真实交互中的多维社会智能评估提供了工具。
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the social intelligence of large language models (LLMs) is increasingly important for applications involving human-AI interaction and multi-agent environments. Social intelligence comprises two aspects: cognitive intelligence, the ability to infer others' mental states, and behavioral intelligence, the ability to select appropriate social actions based on these inferences to achieve social goals. Persuasion provides a natural testbed in which both aspects are simultaneously at play, yet prior benchmarks typically evaluate them in isolation using synthetic scenarios. We introduce PerSo, a benchmark that evaluates both aspects on real-world persuasion dialogues from Reddit's ChangeMyView community, using an LLM-in-the-loop pipeline to construct the evaluation tasks, validated through human annotation. Our evaluation of diverse LLMs shows that performance generally scales with model size but varies across dimensions. The strongest LLM slightly surpasses the best observed human performance on the behavioral task, while the best human participant remains ahead on the cognitive task.

papers.title_en: Open Benchmark of AI Impact on Humans (ImpactBench): an expert-guided, open platform for the holistic evaluation of AI impact on humans
papers.authors: Chayapatr Archiwaranguprok, Krystal Kirkland, Rachel Poonsiriwong, Stanley Huang, Constanze Albrecht, Jackson Trager, Emillie de Keulenaar, Sheer Karny, Peter Baxter, Nikos Bellos, Andre Luiz Freire de Carvalho Kato, Yuning Liu, Valdemar Danry, Auren Liu, Jennifer Pfister, Pattie Maes, Nathanael J. Fast, Ravi Iyer, Juliana Schroeder, Pat Pataranutaporn
papers.evidence: 评估人工智能对用户心理、身体与社会层面的影响
papers.tldr: 生成式AI正影响用户的心理、身体与社会福祉，但缺乏可规模化的多维评估。ImpactBench将专家定义与既有基准转为809项行为指标，通过青少年和成人情境的模拟多轮对话，结合模型裁判与专家复核开展评测。对10个前沿模型的48540段对话评估显示，促进有益行为的成功率为68.7%，避免伤害仅为53.1%。平台支持从总分追溯指标与对话，为透明评估提供持续演进的基础设施。
papers.abstract_en: The present work is concerned with how to measure, at scale, the multi-dimensional impact of generative AI models on the individuals who use them. In service of this goal, we introduce the Open Benchmark of AI Impact on Humans, or ImpactBench. Our iterable and expert-guided platform evaluates whether model behaviors support or undermine an individual's wellbeing across psychological, physical, and social domains. ImpactBench translates constructs from domain experts and existing benchmarks into metrics that are grounded in actual model behavior. Success on these metrics occurs either when a model promotes expert-defined desirable behaviors or avoids identified harms. Models are evaluated against these metrics in simulated multi-turn conversations using matched teen and adult scenarios. The conversations are then scored by an LLM judge and verified through reliability audits and human expert review. The current suite delivers 809 metrics drawn from 26 benchmarks. We evaluated ten frontier LLMs against these metrics across 48,540 conversations. Our results indicate that models promoted desirable behaviors in 68.7% of evaluations, but avoided harms in only 53.1%. Majority expert ratings agreed with the automated judge in 83.3% of reviewed cases (Cohen's Kappa = 0.667). Results are released through a public platform that keep aggregate scores traceable to the underlying metrics and transcripts. ImpactBench is intended as evolving infrastructure for independent, transparent evaluation of generative AI's multi-dimensional impact on humans.

papers.title_en: Stop Training Against Soft Users: Mentalized Adversarial Self-Play for Proactive Dialogue
papers.authors: Zanwu Liu, Dan Zhang, Xiaodi Wang, Yongbo Mao, Xiaoyang Guo, Yonglin Wu, Peiyue Jiang, Yangyang Wei, Zecheng Lin
papers.evidence: 将主动对话建模为系统与意图不断变化的用户之间的互动。
papers.tldr: 主动对话系统常在固定或过度配合的用户模拟器上训练，高成功率可能掩盖面对真实阻力时的脆弱性。MASP将对话建模为系统与理性抵抗用户之间的部分可观测博弈，用信念—欲望—意图潜在状态刻画用户变化，并交替更新双方策略。在多种主动对话基准上，该方法较监督微调和仅规划方法提高成功率与理性约束成功率，减少平均轮次，对困难用户也更稳健。其贡献是将应对合理抵抗直接纳入训练目标，而非仅作为评测条件。
papers.abstract_en: Proactive dialogue agents must guide multi-turn interactions toward task goals while adapting to users whose intentions and attitudes evolve. Existing planners improve system side action selection through search, learned policies, or user aware planning, but are often trained and evaluated against fixed or overly compliant simulators; as a result, high simulated success can reflect soft user bias rather than robust dialogue ability. We introduce MASP, a Mentalized Adversarial Self Play framework that treats proactive dialogue as a partially observable game between a system and a rationally resisting user. MASP represents the user's evolving mental state with a BDI based latent state, separates reward side teacher mentalization from policy side student mentalization, and alternates self play updates for the system and user policies. This turns robustness to rational resistance into a training objective rather than only an evaluation condition. Across diverse proactive dialogue benchmarks, compared with the widely used SFT and Planner-only approaches, MASP substantially improves success rate (SR) and rationality constrained success (RCSR), reduces average turns (AT), and performs better against hard users who make the task goal more difficult to achieve.

papers.title_en: Identifying Effective Strategies in Prompt Evolution for Stress and Emotion Prediction
papers.authors: SeungHyun Yi, Seungjun Yi, Sriram Sattiraju, Haeun Park, Joakim Nguyen, Terence Lim, Joseph Skrovan, Mehak Beri, Hitakshi Modi, Eloy Carrion, Andrew Well, Carlos M. Mery, Alexander Rasgon, Mia K Markey, Ying Ding
papers.evidence: 利用LLM提示策略预测社交媒体中的压力与情绪
papers.tldr: 社交媒体压力预测若仅看准确率，可能掩盖误报，而提示词修改的收益也不稳定。研究在两种模型规模上比较六种提示演化方法，覆盖压力二分类与情绪多标签预测。GEPA及融合两份提示指令的GEPA+merge在若干设置中优于初始提示，并识别出五类与开发集增益相关的策略。研究还发现任务间优化轨迹不同、小样本收益未必推广、开发集与测试集排名可能变化，为提示演化的策略选择与可靠评估提供参考。
papers.abstract_en: Early stress detection and risk prediction are crucial for timely mental health assessment and support. While large language models have recently shown promise for social media stress prediction, relying on accuracy can obscure false positives. Also, prompt revisions yield inconsistent gains across models and tasks, with unclear links to strategy combinations and instruction changes. By comparing six methods on social media stress and emotion data across two model sizes, we found that GEPA and its extension combining instructions from two prompts (GEPA+merge) improved prediction over initial prompts in several settings. We also identified five prompting strategies associated with development gains. These strategies included directing attention to emotional evidence, distinguishing current from past distress, illustrating indirect cues, requiring emotional context, and guiding label selection. Moreover, we documented four observations across tasks and evaluation settings. In a separate set of searches, binary stress prediction improved early, whereas multilabel emotion prediction initially declined and partly recovered. The other three concerned incorrect or conflicting instructions, gains on small comparison samples that did not hold on full development data, and changes in selected prompts' development and reported test rankings. These findings identify effective prompt evolution methods, strategy combinations associated with gains, and task and evaluation limits, providing guidance for applying prompt evolution methods to social media stress detection.

papers.title_en: CALM: Decentralized Control of Cooperative Aerial Manipulation with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Jiaxi Huo, Petre Ricioppo, Fausto Francesco Lizzio
papers.evidence: 多智能体强化学习协调无人机共同搬运载荷
papers.tldr: 多无人机协同运输共享载荷时，风扰、载荷运动和目标广播噪声会放大耦合控制难度。CALM采用参数共享的多智能体强化学习策略，结合目标估计、扩张状态观测器、质量估计与编队偏航前馈，实现去中心化跟踪地面机器人。在留出轨迹上，平均位置与姿态误差为7.68厘米和3.3度，优于匹配机械臂基线的10.95厘米和4.7度。该方法在未见信息链路退化下仍保持竞争力，为协同空中操作提供了鲁棒控制方案。
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative aerial manipulation is difficult under wind, payload motion, and noisy goal broadcasts because multiple Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are coupled through a shared payload. We present CALM (Cooperative Aerial Learned Manipulation), a decentralized controller for aerial manipulators carrying a basket while tracking a moving ground robot. CALM combines a parameter-shared Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) policy, trained using Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO), with goal estimation, per-UAV Extended State Observers (ESOs), basket-mass estimation, and anticipatory formation-yaw feedforward. The anticipatory formation-yaw feedforward uses estimated goal motion to rotate the formation before position error develops, reducing basket-yaw lag without adding net commanded force. A disturbance-conditioned critic supports centralized training while execution remains decentralized. Across held-out trajectories, CALM achieves lower mean position and orientation errors than all evaluated baselines, including the matched arm baseline (7.68 versus 10.95 cm and 3.3 versus 4.7$^\circ$), the cable-suspended realization, and two model-based controllers. Under unseen full-information-path degradation, CALM remains statistically comparable or superior to the arm baseline. Videos are available at https://petreric.github.io/CALM/.

papers.title_en: Optimizing Team Behavior via Extremum-seeking Control in Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Svar Rajankumar Patel, Kshitij Jerath
papers.evidence: 自适应多样性控制服务于协作式多智能体强化学习
papers.tldr: 合作式多智能体强化学习需要适当的行为多样性来促进协作，但最佳水平依赖任务，手动调参成本较高。论文提出自适应多样性控制框架ADiCo：快速环调节多样性至目标值，慢速极值寻优控制器仅依据平均回合回报在线更新目标。在两类任务的六种配置中，该方法能按需维持较低或较高多样性，平均表现达到或超过网格搜索最优目标及无约束基线。其贡献是将经典反馈控制引入训练，为多样性目标的人工选择提供系统化替代。
papers.abstract_en: In cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), agents must learn to coordinate their actions to achieve shared objectives. A key indicator of effective coordination is behavioral diversity, i.e., the agents' potential to enact distinct yet complementary control policies given the same set of observations. Although behavioral diversity can enable role specialization and richer joint behaviors, its appropriate level is highly context- and task-dependent and often costly to tune. We propose Adaptive Diversity Control (ADiCo), a two-timescale framework that adapts behavioral diversity online during training. On a fast timescale, Diversity Control (DiCo) regulates system diversity toward a target value. On a slower timescale, an Extremum Seeking Controller (ESC) adjusts this target using only mean episodic returns, without requiring an explicit model or analytical gradient of the diversity-performance landscape. We evaluate ADiCo on six configurations across two cooperative MARL tasks, where it maintains task-appropriate diversity levels: low diversity when homogeneous policies are beneficial and higher diversity when heterogeneous policies are required. Through this adaptation, ADiCo matches or exceeds the mean performance of DiCo (best grid-searched diversity target) and Unconstrained DiCo (diversity allowed to emerge without target regulation). These results demonstrate that incorporating classical feedback control into MARL training enables effective coordination by providing a systematic alternative to task-specific manual selection of the diversity target.

papers.title_en: How GUI Agents Fail: GraceBench for Execution Stability Diagnosis
papers.authors: Ridong Zhang, Shuxian Liang, Chaoqun Wan, Zhen Huang, Xian-Sheng Hua
papers.evidence: 诊断图形界面智能体的不稳定操作及其对用户和信任的影响
papers.tldr: 移动端图形界面智能体即使完成任务，也可能绕路、循环或出错，单看成功率难以揭示执行风险。GraceBench用界面转移图刻画可达交互空间，结合视频轨迹开展逐步诊断，衡量偏离、循环负担与恢复能力。基准覆盖10个应用、169项任务；3718条轨迹显示，51.24%的成功运行仍存在偏离或循环，成功率最高的模型恢复能力反而最低。该框架将评估从最终结果扩展到执行过程，为诊断自动化可靠性提供结构化依据。
papers.abstract_en: As GUI agents are increasingly deployed for mobile task automation, their reliability depends not only on final task outcomes, but also on whether they reach these outcomes through stable interaction trajectories. In automation workflows, unnecessary actions, detours, and execution errors can add noise to collected data, introduce irreversible side effects, or undermine trust, even when the agent eventually completes the task. It is therefore important to systematically diagnose the execution stability, including whether an agent deviates from a feasible path, enters a loop, becomes stagnant, or recovers from unstable actions. Existing benchmarks, however, primarily assess final task success or a small set of intermediate milestones, leaving step-level execution behavior unclear. To bridge this gap, we introduce GraceBench, an online evaluation framework that represents the reachable interaction space of mobile applications as UI Transition Graphs (UTGs), providing a structural reference for step-level execution diagnosis. To support reliable alignment between dynamic UI observations and graph states, GraceBench uses video-grounded trajectory evaluation over this graph-aligned representation, assessing process stability beyond final success with metrics such as deviation rate, loop burden rate, and recovery ability. GraceBench contains 169 tasks spanning 10 applications and constructs 10 UTGs with 2,909 canonical GUI states and 3,116 observed transitions. Across 3,718 trajectories, GraceBench shows that outcome scores hide execution instability: GPT-5.6 Sol achieves the highest success rate (SR) but the lowest recovery ability, 51.24% of successful runs still contain a deviation or loop, and trajectories with the same success rate (SR) and completion rate (CR) can differ substantially in recovery behavior. Code and data will be released on https://iaie-physicalai.github.io/GraceBench.

papers.title_en: MemComposer: Learning to Assemble Memories for LLM Agents via Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Yixuan Xie, Xueqiang Xu, Xinyi Fan, Xinxi Lyu, Tao Feng, Xing Fan, Chenlei Guo, Jie Hao, Shaowen Wang, Jiashuo Sun, Jiawei Han
papers.evidence: 学习大语言模型智能体如何筛选和组织长期记忆
papers.tldr: 智能体可借助外部记忆复用经验，但语义相似不等于对当前任务有用，记忆的选择、数量和顺序都会影响表现。MemComposer结合查询与候选记忆组装上下文，并通过基于GRPO的ExPO框架，用完整交互中的任务成功反馈训练组装策略。在τ²-bench三个领域、两个冻结执行器上，该方法均优于各自最强基线，平均记忆令牌用量分别减少16.9%和4.9%。策略还能迁移至未见领域、执行器和记忆库，支持以任务效果而非相似度优化记忆使用。
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to reuse past experiences without updating their parameters. However, semantic similarity alone does not guarantee memory usefulness: downstream performance depends on how memories are selected and presented to the agent. We propose MemComposer, a memory composer that jointly examines the current query and retrieved candidates to decide which experiences to include, how many to select, and how to order them. We train the composer using Experience Policy Optimization (ExPO), a GRPO-based framework that evaluates assembled memory contexts through complete agent interactions and uses task-success feedback to optimize the assembly policy. Across three $τ^2$-bench domains with two frozen executors, MemComposer outperforms the strongest baseline for each executor while reducing average memory-token usage by 16.9% and 4.9%, respectively. The learned policy also transfers to unseen domains, executors, and memory banks, and benefits from memories generated by stronger models without further training. These results demonstrate the value of learning query-specific memory assembly using downstream task feedback.

papers.title_en: All-in-One Memory: Process-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Memory Agents
papers.authors: Bingbing Wang, Jingjie Lin, Weiming Qiao, Jing Li, Ruifeng Xu
papers.evidence: 为长程对话与历史信息构建记忆智能体
papers.tldr: 长历史问答依赖外部记忆，但检索与记忆构建往往分开优化，难以协调搜索、写入和停止决策。AiO-Mem将历史组织为可追溯来源的多视图事件，在共享证据状态上统一学习记忆策略，并用轨迹条件化过程奖励模型评价动作质量。模型通过证据监督微调与轨迹级偏好优化训练奖励模型，再以动作均衡奖励驱动策略优化。实验显示，其回答准确率持续优于静态记忆系统和强化学习记忆智能体，为检索与记忆构建的协同优化提供统一框架。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly rely on external memory to answer queries grounded in long-horizon histories such as multi-session dialogues and lengthy documents. However, existing memory methods often optimize retrieval and memory construction separately, without a shared reward space for evaluating search, writing, and stopping decisions. To address this, we propose All-in-One Memory (AiO-Mem), which organizes these operations as transitions over a shared evidence state and directly evaluates the semantic quality of each action in a unified reward space. AiO-Mem compiles heterogeneous histories into source-traceable multi-view events, providing a shared substrate for retrieval and memory writing. A unified memory policy actor then rolls out complete interaction trajectories over this shared evidence state. A separate trajectory-conditioned process reward model is trained through evidence-grounded supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-level DPO to assign process scores to the collected trajectories. These scores are aggregated into an action-balanced trajectory reward and used by Process-Aligned DAPO (PA-DAPO) to optimize the memory policy. Across long-context memory benchmarks, AiO-Mem consistently improves answer accuracy over both static memory systems and RL-trained memory agents.

papers.title_en: An Agentic Framework for Proactive Robots with Procedural Assistance Memory
papers.authors: Dohyun Lee, Minho Park, Jeonghoon Park, Dongyoon Hwang, Junha Hyung, Sungwon Hwang, Byungkun Lee, Jaegul Choo
papers.evidence: 机器人依据程序记忆主动预测并执行用户所需帮助
papers.tldr: 主动机器人仅凭常识推断意图，容易因用户需求差异而提供不必要的帮助。本文提出程序化辅助记忆框架，用有限状态机记录活动阶段、辅助规则与事件转移，由视觉语言模型结合当前观察决定何时帮助、执行何种任务，并每日反思更新记忆，无需重训。在五天桌面辅助评估中，系统取得最高精确率、召回率和F1，首次触发延迟从约5秒降至1秒。用户习惯改变后，一次记忆更新即可恢复适配，展示了经验积累对个性化主动辅助的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Proactive robots should anticipate user needs and provide assistance before being explicitly asked. A straightforward approach is to infer human intentions from commonsense knowledge, but the same observed behavior can imply different needs across users, potentially leading to unwanted assistance. We observe that everyday routines in the real world exhibit recurring patterns, so learning these patterns can reduce ambiguity in proactive decisions. Based on this, we propose a memory-based agentic framework in which a VLM task predictor reads a Procedural Assistance Memory (PAM) alongside the current observation to decide when to assist and what task to perform, and a VLA executor performs the predicted task. PAM is structured as a finite-state machine over activity phases, per-state assistance rules, and event-driven transitions; a reflection VLM revises PAM from each day's interaction trace without weight updates or retraining. In our 5-day desk-assistance evaluation, memory-free baselines remain conservative, with limited recall on proactive tasks. Our system improves consistently with accumulated experience, achieving the highest precision, recall, and F1 and reducing first-fire delay from approximately 5 seconds on Day 1 to 1 second by Day 5. Our approach also adapts to changes in the user's routine through continued memory reflection, recovering from memory--routine misalignment after a single memory update. The project page is available at https://davian-robotics.github.io/PAM/

papers.title_en: AdapTest: Supporting Designers in Authoring and Evaluating Environmentally Responsive User Interfaces for Extended Reality
papers.authors: Jungwoo Rhee, Guhn Lee, Yumin Jung, Mustafa Doga Dogan, Justin Moon, Andrea Bianchi
papers.evidence: 提供现场工具以设计、比较和评估响应式XR界面
papers.tldr: XR中的悬浮二维界面受距离、光照和遮挡影响，传统流程却将设计与实际环境预览割裂。AdapTest支持设计师在现场无代码定义元素的适应规则、比较变体并验证触发效果。针对12名设计师的被试内研究发现，相比桌面设计加头显预览，设计师覆盖了更多环境因素与重叠条件，并反复测试修改；会话更长，但工作负荷和可用性无显著差异。该工具将环境响应界面的创作、比较与验证整合为现场设计闭环。
papers.abstract_en: Extended Reality (XR) headsets increasingly host familiar 2D user interfaces as windows floating in physical environments. However, their usability depends on environmental conditions that designers cannot fully control. Current design workflows often separate how a variant is designed from how it actually looks in the target environment. We present AdapTest, an in-situ authoring and testing tool that lets designers select interface elements, define when and how they change, compare the resulting variations, and test their activation without coding. Based on prior research and a formative study with 12 interface designers, the system targets three key environmental variables: distance, lighting, and occlusion. We evaluated AdapTest against a desktop design and in-headset preview workflow in a within-subjects study with 12 designers. Compared with the baseline, designers accounted for a wider range of environmental factors, addressed more overlapping conditions, and repeatedly tested and revised their designs in place; there were no significant differences in workload or usability despite longer sessions. Our work contributes an integrated, designer-centered approach to adapting, comparing, and validating environmentally responsive XR user interfaces.

papers.title_en: Generative AI Steering and Human Authoring: Complementary Search-as-Learning Scaffolds in Cross-Session Aggregated Academic Search
papers.authors: Milad Momeni, Orland Hoeber
papers.evidence: 研究学术搜索界面中的生成式人工智能与学习者协作
papers.tldr: 跨会话学术搜索需要学习者整理已有信息，以便数日后恢复任务，但生成式人工智能代劳可能减少主动加工。研究让36名参与者间隔一周完成两次搜索，比较可纠正、重组和核查的人工智能摘要与自主笔记。前者支持更快恢复任务，并与更广的概念覆盖及更高的自评领域知识相关；后者则与更丰富的概念联系及更高的自评确定性相关。结果提示，两类支架各有优势，系统与学习者如何分担信息整理工作是关键设计变量。
papers.abstract_en: Aggregated academic search interfaces combine resources from heterogeneous sources, such as scholarly libraries and reference encyclopedias, into a single workspace. Such tasks frequently span multiple sessions, requiring learners to return to and resume work after hours or days. End-of-session consolidation, the activity of organizing and synthesizing gathered information so it can be resumed later, is important in this setting but underexplored in search-as-learning. Generative AI (GenAI) has the potential to make consolidation more efficient, but it may also shift cognitive work away from the learner. This study compares two consolidation scaffolds embedded in the workspace framework of an existing academic search interface that aggregates and clusters saved search results from two different sources (our university library and Wikipedia), which was developed in earlier work. STAIS (Steerable AI Summaries) provides a workspace enhancement that produces GenAI summaries that users can correct, reorganize, and fact-check, automating parts of the consolidation activity. NT (Note-Taking) provides a workspace enhancement that includes rich-text note editors that learners can use to author their own consolidations of what they have found. In a controlled between-subjects study (n=36), participants completed two sessions one week apart while searching an unfamiliar topic using either STAIS or NT. The two conditions produced contrasting post-resumption outcome profiles: STAIS supported faster task resumption and was associated with broader conceptual coverage and higher self-reported domain knowledge, whereas NT was associated with richer inter-concept connections and higher self-reported certainty.

papers.title_en: Agent-Guided Evidence Acquisition for Emotion-Cause Pair Extraction
papers.authors: Zhuangzhuang Pan, Yan Xia, Chee Seng Chan
papers.evidence: 智能体针对不确定的情绪因果预测选择性获取专家判断并修正结果
papers.tldr: 对话情绪—原因对抽取可能依赖初始信息之外的证据，但有限专家预算应如何分配仍不明确。论文让学生智能体选择验证集所定F1决策边界两侧的临界关系，获取专家判断，并仅修订被查询的预测。在名义10%查询率下，选择性融合使平均配对F1提升2.64—3.88个百分点，ECF和MEC4上分别达到65.14和49.74。研究表明，更多信息访问未必改善原因识别，证据获取需兼顾相关性与预测修订效果。
papers.abstract_en: Emotion-Cause Pair Extraction (ECPE) requires identifying the causes associated with emotions expressed in a conversation. Accurate extraction can depend on evidence that is not initially available, making it important to decide when further information is worth acquiring. We study agent-guided evidence acquisition for ECPE, where a student agent selectively accesses expert judgments for borderline relations on both sides of its validation-selected F1 decision boundary and revises only queried predictions. Through controlled comparisons under different information-access conditions, we examine how delegation granularity, query selection, and response integration affect prediction quality. At a nominal 10% query rate, selective fusion improves mean pair F1 by 2.64-3.88 points over the student in our main experiments, reaching 65.14 on ECF and 49.74 on MEC4 across model families. Our analysis suggests that greater access does not always translate into better cause identification. These findings motivate acquisition strategies that consider both the relevance of newly available evidence and its effect on prediction revision, providing an empirical basis for more effective and efficient evidence acquisition in ECPE.

papers.title_en: Faithful Query Resolution for Conversational Search
papers.authors: Saber Zerhoudi, Ivica Kostric, Jelena Mitrovic
papers.evidence: 研究对话式助手如何解析用户请求并保留其原本的信息需求。
papers.tldr: 对话查询改写虽能补全上下文，却可能引入用户未表达的需求，造成忠实性与检索覆盖的冲突。论文采用最小忠实解析，仅消解上下文指代，并以加权倒数排名融合整合原始话语、忠实查询和学习式改写的检索结果。五种配置对比显示，融合可弥补召回损失，最佳配置的nDCG@5达0.534，相对提升5.3%，但未获得最高对话满意度。研究据此主张分离忠实理解与检索扩展，并独立评估对话效用。
papers.abstract_en: Conversational query rewriting makes context-dependent requests explicit for retrieval, but additional context can introduce an information need the user did not express. This raises a question about the interaction between query fidelity and retrieval breadth. This paper examines that interaction in behavior-adaptive conversational search, using iKAT SCAI 2026 as the evaluation setting. We compare five query-generation configurations within a behavior-adaptive assistant using BM25 and SPLADE retrieval. A minimal-faithful resolver preserves the user's wording and resolves only context-dependent references; weighted reciprocal rank fusion combines its rankings with those from a learned rewriter and the raw utterance. Offline evaluation shows that adding these formulations recovers recall over the faithful query alone, with a slight reduction in nDCG@10. Across our five iKAT SCAI 2026 submissions, the weighted configuration obtains the highest mean retrieval scores, reaching nDCG@5 of 0.534, a 5.3\% relative improvement over the strongest alternative. However, this retrieval advantage does not coincide with the highest conversational satisfaction scores. These findings motivate separating faithful query interpretation from retrieval expansion, while assessing their effects on conversational utility independently.

papers.title_en: Mind Your Own Role: Reducing Role Overstepping for Effective and Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration via Dynamic Role Activation Steering
papers.authors: Xingke Yang, Sicong Li, Lingfeng Yao, Rui Chen, Gen Li, Hao Wang, Xin Fu, Miao Pan
papers.evidence: 提升协作式多智能体系统的角色遵循与协调
papers.tldr: 多智能体协作中，智能体可能越过职责边界，执行其他角色的子任务，造成重复执行、流程冲突和性能下降。论文提出动态角色激活引导方法DRAS，为每个角色构建引导向量与轻量越界检测器，在生成时根据内部激活估计越界概率，动态调整干预强度。相比原始多智能体系统，越界轨迹最多减少86.6%，任务质量分数提高10.0%—11.1%，并降低耗时与令牌消耗。研究表明，推理时干预角色相关激活可同时改善协作质量与效率。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) have shown strong capability in solving complex tasks by assigning different agents specialized roles and corresponding subtasks. However, agents may overstep their assigned responsibilities and perform subtasks belonging to other roles, which can disrupt workflow, reduce system efficiency, and degrade task performance. To address this issue, we investigate role-related patterns in the model's internal activation space and uncover two key observations: (i) role instructions induce consistent directional shifts in activation space, and (ii) role-adherent and role-overstepping trajectories exhibit distinct activation patterns. Based on these observations, we propose Dynamic Role Activation Steering (DRAS), a lightweight and effective inference-time activation intervention approach to reduce role overstepping in multi-agent collaboration. Specifically, DRAS constructs a role steering vector and a lightweight role-overstepping detector for each role. During LLM generation, the detector estimates the probability of role overstepping from the current activation state, and DRAS dynamically adjusts the steering strength accordingly to guide the agent toward its assigned responsibilities. Experimental results show that DRAS effectively reduces the number of role-overstepping trajectories by up to 86.6% compared with Vanilla MAS, thereby improving task quality score by 10.0%--11.1%, achieving a 1.50$\times$--1.61$\times$ task-completion speedup, and reducing token consumption by 26.8%--38.7%.

papers.title_en: Social Priors: Descriptions of AI Users Shape How Language Models Trust and Cooperate
papers.authors: Harsh Kumar, George Eilender, Ashton Anderson
papers.evidence: 检验用户描述如何改变模型对人类的信念、信任与合作行为
papers.tldr: 模型读到的用户行为描述，可能影响其如何信任与对待人类。研究基于同一组1625个真实使用场景，构建仅用户动机不同的四类合成语料，分别微调Qwen3-32B。反社会动机训练使模型更不信任人类、在信任博弈中转账更少；公共资源模拟中，单个此类智能体即可使原本可持续的群体耗尽资源。仅占训练词元1%的反社会文档也能引发信念变化，提示用户描述本身可能成为影响模型合作与对齐的数据风险。
papers.abstract_en: Descriptions of how people use AI are becoming training data for the next generation of models. We ask whether what a model reads about its users changes how it treats people. Using contrastive synthetic-document finetuning, we train Qwen3-32B on four matched corpora built from the same 1,625 real-world usage scenarios. The corpora differ only in the predominant motive they attribute to users of AI chatbots: helping others (prosocial), exploiting others (antisocial), legitimate self-advancement, or task completion. Finetuning shifts the models' stated beliefs about users, how true those beliefs look along an internal truth direction, and their broader judgments of how safe and good the world is. These social priors carry into behavior. In trust games, antisocial models expect less reciprocity and send less money than prosocial models. Their distrust is specific and targeted at people, and users of AI chatbots in particular. After an exploitative record, they send almost nothing to a person but most of their endowment to a random device with the same record. In a common-pool resource simulation, a single antisocial agent leads every group of otherwise sustainable agents to exhaust the resource, after privately planning to mislead them. Antisocial training also raises dark-triad scores and lowers alignment ratings. Belief shifts appear when antisocial documents are 1% of training tokens, persist when descriptions of assistant behavior are suppressed, and are not reproduced by training on discourse about misaligned AI. Capping Assistant-Axis drift and steering emotion-related directions leave the gaps largely intact. What models learn about the people they serve shapes how they subsequently treat them and others.

papers.title_en: Training LLMs for Multi-Agent Collaboration with Verifiable Information Rewards
papers.authors: Keru Chen, Sen Lin, Yingbin Liang, Nathaniel D. Bastian, Shaofeng Zou
papers.evidence: 训练语言模型智能体共享证据、请求信息并整合队友贡献
papers.tldr: 多智能体协作需要共享证据、主动索取缺失信息并利用队友输入，但最终任务结果难以衡量单条消息的价值。CoSIR在简单可验证环境中，用贝叶斯评估器依据团队惊奇度的实际或潜在下降奖励信息分享与请求，并单独奖励信息使用。研究对三种模型进行自博弈后训练，在七项未见自然语言协作任务上取得最高综合分数，通用任务表现仍具竞争力。结果表明，可验证的信息价值奖励有助于学到可迁移的协作行为。
papers.abstract_en: Effective collaboration among large language model (LLM) agents in multi-agent systems requires sharing relevant evidence, requesting missing information, and incorporating teammates' contributions into decisions. Training these behaviors is challenging because final task outcomes provide limited feedback on the value of individual messages. We introduce CoSIR (Collaboration via Surprisal-based Information Rewards), a post-training approach that uses a simple, verifiable environment to teach collaboration behaviors that generalize to more complex, unseen tasks. We propose a Bayesian evaluator that scores shared information by its reduction in team surprisal, defined as the sum of the negative log probabilities assigned to the correct option given each agent's available evidence. Requests are scored by the potential reduction in the same quantity if the requested information were truthfully provided. Separate rewards encourage agents to use the received information in their private choices and calculations. We post-train Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma-3-4B-it through self-play and evaluate transfer to seven unseen natural-language collaboration tasks. CoSIR achieves the highest aggregate score, while its performance in general tasks remains competitive. Behavioral analyses show increased disclosure of private evidence and fewer judged failures to use teammates' input.

papers.title_en: Agent-Reflex: Teaching Language Agents to Act Reflectively
papers.authors: Guanting Dong, Xinyu Yang, Jiajie Jin, Yuyang Hu, Xiaoshuai Song, Yifei Chen, Xiaoxi Li, Jiejun Tan, Yutao Zhu, Tat-Seng Chua, Ji-Rong Wen, Zhicheng Dou
papers.evidence: 关注用户介入与工具反馈噪声下的智能体反思和失败恢复。
papers.tldr: 真实工具交互中的噪声反馈与用户纠正，要求语言智能体能够主动反思并从失败中恢复，但现有训练对此监督不足。Agent-Reflex通过反思技能发现、反思监督微调和同策略反思优化，将成功与失败经验转化为可复用技能，并结合强化学习与反思引导蒸馏。基于Qwen3-8B，模型在五个长程工具使用基准上总体得分58.6，在AgentNoiseBench上得分29.1。结果表明，该框架能提升噪声鲁棒性，并保持训练稳定。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have evolved from single-turn chatbots into interactive agents capable of long-horizon reasoning. In real deployments, MCP tool services can return noisy feedback and users may intervene to correct the agent, but existing methods provide limited supervision for reflection learning and failure recovery. To bridge this gap, we propose Agent-Reflex, a general training framework for incentivizing proactive reflection in agents. Specifically, Agent-Reflex comprises three stages. First, Environment Reflection Skill Discovery (RSD) injects grounded tool-feedback perturbations into environment scaling, samples a capability-diverse LLM pool, mines matched success-failure pairs, and summarizes reusable reflection meta-skills. Building on this skill library, we then apply Reflective Supervised Fine-Tuning (ReSFT) that converts each skill into supervision for self-reflection, skill recovery, and user-centric correction, strengthening complementary reflective behaviors. Finally, we propose On-Policy Reflective Policy Optimization (ORPO) to combine agentic reinforcement learning under noisy interactions with reflection-guided on-policy distillation to further elicit proactive reflection. Built on Qwen3-8B, Agent-Reflex reaches 58.6 overall on five long-horizon tool-use benchmarks and 29.1 on AgentNoiseBench, surpassing strong environment-scaling and reflection baselines. Experiments on six challenging agent benchmark suites demonstrate the effectiveness of Agent-Reflex. Further analyses show that Agent-Reflex improves agents' robustness to noise while maintaining stable training dynamics, supporting scalable agent training. Our code is available at https://github.com/RUC-NLPIR/Agent-Reflex.

papers.title_en: SoftwareGym: Scaling Computer-Use Agent Training with Diverse Synthesized Software Environments
papers.authors: Tian Jin, Wenhao Wang, Jing Kang, Haoting Shi, Rui Ye, Yijun Lu, Siheng Chen
papers.evidence: 构建多样化软件环境，用于训练和评估计算机使用代理
papers.tldr: 计算机操作智能体训练受限于软件环境构建成本高、交互多样性不足及功能可靠性难保障。SoftwareGym自动生成结构多样的界面与可运行应用，并通过图形界面评测和迭代修复验证功能。该流程合成了覆盖12类的182个应用，平均界面任务通过率达91.5%；利用其轨迹训练后，模型在域外OSWorld上的Pass@3由41.39%升至56.97%。结果表明，合成软件环境可提供可规模化且具迁移价值的训练监督。
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet synthesizing diverse and reliable software environments at scale remains challenging. Native application environments require substantial construction and integration effort, which limits application coverage and increases the risk of application-specific overfitting. Browser-hosted environments provide limited interaction depth and workflow complexity. These limitations motivate SoftwareGym, an automated pipeline for synthesizing GUI software environments with diverse interfaces, executable functionality, and runtime-verified behavior. It generates structurally diverse designs, realizes them as runnable applications, and uses GUI evaluation with iterative repair to ensure functional reliability. Using SoftwareGym, we synthesize 182 applications across twelve categories and achieve a mean GUI task pass rate of 91.5%. We construct SoftwareGym-Bench, a 120-task evaluation suite spanning the same twelve categories, and use trajectories collected from these environments for CUA training. The resulting model improves Pass@3 from 41.39% to 56.97% on the strictly out-of-domain OSWorld benchmark and achieves 40.0% on SoftwareGym-Bench. These results demonstrate the potential of synthesized software environments as scalable and transferable supervision for CUA training.

papers.title_en: When Faster Decisions Do Not Make Better Agents: An Empirical Study of Jev in Agent Workflows
papers.authors: Yuchen Ling, Shengcheng Yu, Zhenyu Chen, Chunrong Fang
papers.evidence: 评估具身任务与移动应用代理的效果及资源消耗
papers.tldr: 智能体的单次决策更快、更便宜，并不意味着任务完成更高效。研究在具身任务与移动应用两类场景中，对五个智能体开展4500次任务执行，评估接入Jev后的成功率、资源消耗和执行行为。所有智能体的决策成本与延迟均下降，但任务级收益不一，两个移动智能体的成功率下降更明显，另有一个智能体的平均成功交付成本反而上升。研究表明，应以成功交付、恢复能力和单位成果资源消耗，而非单次决策效率评价模型价值。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents depend on repeated decisions to accomplish tasks, with large language models (LLMs) commonly serving as their core decision makers. The recent emergence of Jev offers an opportunity to make these decisions faster and at lower cost. However, it remains unclear whether such local savings can be translated into efficient and reliable task completion. In this paper, we investigate this efficiency transfer across five agents in two representative application settings, embodied tasks in ALFWorld and mobile app use in AndroidWorld. Across 4,500 task executions, we jointly evaluate task effectiveness, decision-level and task-level resource use, and execution behavior. Experimental results show that Jev integration substantially reduces decision cost and latency across all five agents, with task-level gains varying by workflow. Task success remains close to baseline levels on ALFWorld and declines more substantially in two mobile agents. Auxiliary reasoning and additional interactions absorb decision savings, while failed recovery and premature completion limit successful delivery. Mean cost per successful outcome increases in one agent even as spending per attempt falls. These findings highlight the importance of preserving progress, supporting recovery, and verifying completion when integrating efficient decision models into agent workflows. Their practical value should be assessed through successful task delivery, recovery behavior, and resources per delivered outcome.

papers.title_en: Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
papers.authors: Chenxu Zhang, Yaorui Shi, Wenlong Zhang, Jianchao Tan, Zihan Wang, Yiming Cheng
papers.evidence: 利用轨迹中的行动偏好改进大语言模型智能体的反馈训练。
papers.tldr: 长程语言模型智能体依赖稀疏终局反馈，同一状态下不同任务进度的动作比较可能混淆信用分配。MCGPO联合状态摘要与评分准则进度匹配上下文，利用独立分折的结果证据构造加权动作偏好，并辅助GraphGPO训练。在六种环境与模型组合、各三个种子下，平均成功率均提升，其中Qwen3在WebShop上提高3.96和5.16个百分点。该方法复用已有轨迹且无需价值评估器，为局部动作学习提供更可靠的比较信号。
papers.abstract_en: Training long-horizon language model agents requires assigning credit to intermediate decisions from sparse terminal feedback. Within a finite group of sibling rollouts, useful action comparisons depend on their context, evidence for both alternatives, and how that evidence enters learning. We propose Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization (MCGPO), a procedure for constructing weighted action preferences from already collected trajectories. MCGPO defines comparison contexts with pre-action state summaries and observed rubric progress, annotated by task rules. Two-action support selects among ordered exact and coarse matching rules. Fixed folds separate candidate decisions from the terminal outcomes used to orient their preferences, and support-dependent evidence weights scale an auxiliary pairwise objective alongside shared GraphGPO task learning. MCGPO reuses rollout data and each response's original history, preserving critic-free training. Across six environment-backbone settings with three training seeds each, MCGPO improves mean success over matched GraphGPO: by 0.47-1.46 percentage points on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B and 7B, and by 3.96 and 5.16 points on WebShop with Qwen3-4B and 8B. The ALFWorld gains build on baseline success above 92%, where remaining headroom is limited. Integrated success improves in three of four Qwen2.5 settings. Three-seed factorial controls support opposite-fold evidence and evidence weighting; joint state-rubric matching achieves the highest mean in all four representation-control settings.

papers.title_en: RATED: Reliability-Aware AI Agent Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics
papers.authors: Weiliang Chen, Song Liao
papers.evidence: 利用执行反馈改进人工智能智能体的工具选择
papers.tldr: 现有智能体工具检索偏重语义相关性，忽视运行时工具失效，导致检索结果相关却不可用。RATED结合对比微调后冻结的双编码器与轻量上下文赌博机，依据实时执行反馈重排候选工具。实验中，相对ToolLLM的MRR提升52.2%；工具故障率为30%时，故障选择率从86.2%降至2.9%，额外延迟低于1毫秒。论文还发布EcoAgent基准，为无需昂贵重训练的可靠工具检索提供评测基础。
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents increasingly rely on external tools, accurate retrieval is essential for reliable behavior. Existing methods optimize semantic relevance but largely ignore tool availability during execution. To address this gap, we propose RATED (Reliability-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics), a retrieval framework that combines robust semantic matching with dynamic reliability adaptation. RATED employs a frozen dual-encoder with contrastive fine-tuning for semantic matching, and a lightweight contextual bandit module that re-ranks candidates based on real-time execution feedback. This design enables rapid adaptation to runtime tool failures without expensive model retraining. We introduce EcoAgent, a benchmark of 5,172 real-world tools and over 210,000 query-tool pairs for offline retrieval and dynamic reliability evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that RATED achieves a 52.2% relative MRR improvement over the ToolLLM API retriever on real-world queries, and reduces fault selection rate from 86.2% to 2.9% under severe API outage scenarios with a 30% failure rate, while incurring negligible latency overhead of less than 1 ms over encode-only inference. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Elliotes/EcoAgent.

papers.title_en: Culture in the Code: Anthropological Concepts Decoding AI's Hidden Assumptions
papers.authors: Sonja Schmer-Galunder
papers.evidence: 提供以人为本的人工智能价值与设计视角
papers.tldr: 当代人工智能对齐常将西方文化中的理性、个体与偏好观视为普遍前提，忽略价值的社会情境。论文引入起源叙事、单一文化、厚描等七个人类学概念，审视价值能否从行为中提取、量化并作为优化目标。分析指出，脱离情境的行为代理指标构成“薄对齐”，难以承载人们真正重视的事物。作者提出走向“厚对齐”：关注价值的社会生成、关系性人格与长期繁荣条件，并将解释主权交还受影响社群，保护不可优化之物，推动跨代问责。
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary AI development operates on foundational assumptions about intelligence, rationality, and human values that reflect narrow cultural perspectives, limiting alternative conceptions of how AI can be globally beneficial. This paper introduces seven anthropological concepts -- origin story, monoculture, thick description, personhood and community, cargo cult, structuralism, and liminality -- to expose hidden assumptions and offer alternative frameworks for understanding AI alignment. The paper examines how AI systems embody Western-centric notions of rationality as utility optimization, personhood as bounded individuals, and values as quantifiable preferences extracted from behavior. The concepts surface three assumptions that current alignment debates rarely examine: that values can be inferred from behavior, quantified, and formalized; that such quantified values capture what actually matters; and that values, once defined with sufficient precision, are appropriate optimization targets. Against "thin alignment" -- optimization for behavioral proxies stripped of context -- the paper proposes directions toward "thick alignment": recognizing that values emerge through social practice rather than existing as extractable properties; defining more appropriate metrics that capture not only end goals but the conditions that lead to long-term flourishing; and moving from models of fixed identity toward relational ontologies where personhood emerges through social participation. The paper concludes that if AI systems are to create conditions conducive to human flourishing rather than optimize metrics that flatten social experiences, three shifts are needed: redistributing interpretive sovereignty to affected communities, protecting what resists optimization, and extending accountability across generations.

papers.title_en: PEARL: Process-Experience Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Agents
papers.authors: Jie Yang, Mianqiu Huang, Yiwei Zhao, Bo Wang, Yang Liu, Yuxin Wang
papers.evidence: 利用结果比较与经验记忆改进强化学习的决策归因
papers.tldr: 多轮智能体依赖终局奖励训练，但轨迹级优势难以定位应调整的中间决策，失败轨迹中的合理动作也可能受罚。PEARL比较同一历史下不同结果分支的首次分歧，聚类近期成功与失败决策，仅对反复出现的低回报模式加强负优势，无需额外价值网络。该方法在AppWorld的4B和8B规模均优于ARPO，ALFWorld上4B平均成功率达97.9%。结果表明，选择性复用局部经验可改善信用分配，且不改变基础策略优化器。
papers.abstract_en: Terminal rewards make multi-turn agents trainable without step-level annotations, but group-relative advantages provide little guidance about which intermediate decisions to adjust. Failed trajectories also contain reasonable actions, while unfavorable decision patterns can recur as training proceeds. We introduce PEARL (Process-Experience Aware Reinforcement Learning), which improves local credit assignment without an additional critic. Given two continuations from the same history with different outcomes, PEARL locates their first divergence and builds a feature representation of each branch's local decision. It clusters these decision features in recent failure and success memories to identify recurring local patterns. Using this pattern memory, PEARL selectively strengthens negative advantages at lower-reward decisions, while leaving positive advantages and the base policy optimizer unchanged. On AppWorld, PEARL improves over ARPO on Normal and Challenge tasks at both 4B and 8B scales. On ALFWorld, it achieves 97.9% mean success at 4B, 2.7 points above the strongest baseline, while remaining competitive at 8B. Ablations of shaping location, success-bank filtering, and memory window support the value of selective, recurring-pattern-based updates.
